fusions.name: Curled Tumble
fusions.desc: You tumble in a ball, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Shed Plate
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health and flings a plate that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Scale Roll
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds, with +10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Overlapping Seams
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, you gain a ward that absorbs 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
